title: Vivir en la colonia
goal: Read a synthesis of colonial life and what it left behind, from administration and caste privilege to the Church and the city plan.

items: Describe the lasting mark the viceregal order left on Latin America's social and territorial structures.
Name the institutions that held the system together, such as viceroyalties, audiencias and the Church.
Explain where much of today's colonial-city layout actually came from.
Use passive voice to synthesize several institutions in a single summary.
